tools.name: store_memory
tools.description: Store a new memory in the vault. Routes to org vault if tagged "org". Errors if a memory with the same key already exists — use update_memory, or pass force=true to overwrite (preserves created/accessCount). force=true is refused if the existing memory is tagged "no-prune" (immortal) — use update_memory to amend or delete_memory(force=true) then re-store.

content.description: Full markdown content including executive summary.

force.description: Overwrite an existing memory with the same key (preserves created/accessCount).

key.description: Explicit memory key (overrides the title/category-derived key). Used by import_memories to preserve the original location on a round-trip; rarely set by hand.

created.description: ISO timestamp to record as the creation time (import_memories round-trip). Omit to stamp now.

updated.description: ISO timestamp to record as the last-updated time (import_memories round-trip). Omit to stamp now.

sessions.description: Pre-existing session history to carry over (import_memories round-trip). The current sessionId is appended (deduped, capped at 50).

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Full-text TF-IDF search with Ebbinghaus decay. Fuses with vector search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion when the optional embedding deps are installed (set hybrid=false to force TF-IDF only).

since.description: Relative (7d, 2w, 1m) or ISO date. Lower bound on updated.

before.description: Relative (7d, 2w, 1m) or ISO date. Upper bound on updated (exclusive); combine with since for a date range.

minScore.description: Minimum score; drop results below this. Default 0 = no filtering. Scores are NOT comparable across hybrid modes (RRF-fused scores are tiny; use hybrid=false for predictable TF-IDF thresholds).

hybrid.description: Fuse TF-IDF with vector search (RRF) when available.

tools.name: rerank_memories
tools.description: Reorder a candidate list of memory keys by semantic similarity to a query using embeddings. Returns the same keys sorted by cosine score; pass full=true to include the memory body.

query.description: The query to compare each candidate memory against.

keys.description: Candidate memory keys (e.g. the top-N results from recall_memory or search_index). Capped at 200 keys; extras are dropped (preserving original order).

limit.description: Maximum number of keys to return. Default 0 returns all provided keys.

full.description: Include the full memory content in the result.

tools.name: export_memories
tools.description: Export memories as a portable JSON archive. Optionally filter by keys, category, or tag. Each entry includes the full body content and metadata needed for import_memories.

keys.description: Optional subset of memory keys to export.

tag.description: Filter by tag (any memory that includes this tag).

tools.name: import_memories
tools.description: Import memories from a JSON archive produced by export_memories. Skips existing keys unless force=true.

memories.description: Array of memory objects (key, title, content, category, tags, importanceScore, ...).

force.description: Overwrite existing memories with the same derived key.

tools.name: delete_memories
tools.description: Bulk delete memories by key. Requires confirm=true. Refuses no-prune memories in the batch unless force=true is passed.

force.description: Override the no-prune tag guard for the batch.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the bulk deletion.

tools.name: confirm_memory
tools.description: Confirm or flag a memory. useful=true increments confirmations (reinforces retention); useful=false increments flags (accelerates decay).

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: Metadata-only listing with optional category/tag filter.

offset.description: Skip the first N results (for pagination; combine with limit).

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Update content, tags, or importanceScore of an existing memory.

tools.name: delete_memory
tools.description: Delete a memory from the vault and index. Refuses memories tagged "no-prune" unless force=true is passed.

force.description: Override the no-prune tag guard (use to delete an immortal memory).

tools.name: rebuild_index
tools.description: Full re-scan of both vaults. Rebuilds inverted index. Pass forceReembed=true to additionally drop and re-embed every memory's vector at the current embedding model (one-shot bulk re-embed after a model switch).

forceReembed.description: Drop every stored vector and re-embed all memories at the current embedding model's dimension (one-shot bulk re-embed, e.g. after switching embedding model). Default false keeps rebuild_index cheap (reconcile + inverted rebuild only). Refuses without dropping if the embedder is unavailable.

tools.name: search_index
tools.description: Lightweight metadata-only search (no file reads). Returns key, title, preview, score.

since.description: Relative or ISO date. Lower bound on updated.

before.description: Relative or ISO date. Upper bound on updated (exclusive); combine with since for a date range.

minScore.description: Minimum TF-IDF score; drop results below this. Default 0 = no filtering.

excludeJournal.description: Drop journal entries (auto-appended daily logs). Default true.

tools.name: get_memories_by_keys
tools.description: Batch fetch by keys. Use summary=true for executive summary only (~500 chars).

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Total memories, by-category breakdown, cache stats, performance percentiles.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Chronological view with date grouping and optional filtering.

since.description: Relative or ISO date. Lower bound on updated.

before.description: Relative or ISO date. Upper bound on updated (exclusive); combine with since for a date range.

offset.description: Skip the first N results (for pagination; combine with limit).

tools.name: get_related_memories
tools.description: Jaccard similarity on tags with same-category boost.

tools.name: prune_memories
tools.description: List low-retention candidates using Ebbinghaus model. Does NOT auto-delete. Excludes memories tagged "no-prune" (immortal, e.g. ADRs).
